items.text: Animal biotechnology careers cover breeding and genetics, vaccines and diagnostics, reproductive technologies, aquaculture and livestock health, and they combine lab skill with field understanding under strict animal welfare and biosafety rules.
Learn core molecular and cell techniques, spend time with a livestock or diagnostic lab and document one small project.
Verify approvals and avoid any training that skips them.
